about: Two outputs on one node, both with PowerOnBehaviour = RESTORE: each keeps its OWN state in the persistent store, under a key carrying its endpoint number. With one shared key every output restored the state of whichever switched last (zadania/zrobione/FEAT-02.md, F4). Invert off at first, so the driven level is the state; then Invert written at runtime moves the coil at once (zadania/zrobione/BUG-07.md).

steps.note: each output restored from its own key
Toggle ep5 -> on; ep4 keeps its stored state
this module has Invert (the receiver on the normally-closed contact); a bool takes 0 or 1
Invert = 1 on ep4, which is off: the coil goes ON at once, so the closed contact opens and the receiver stays off — OnOff unchanged, so no report (zadania/zrobione/BUG-07.md)
On ep4 with Invert: the coil goes off
Invert = 0 while on: the coil follows at once
